newsitem.title: USA: U.S. weekly molasses report - June 2.
newsitem.headline: U.S. weekly molasses report - June 2.

text.p: Prices on sugarcane molasses were mixed in the week ended June 2, with Houston and New Orleans steady to $5.00 higher per ton and Baltimore-Philadelphia $5.00-$7.50 lower, USDA Market News said.

Molasses supplies are moderate to good with light to moderate demand and domestic usage remaining light to moderate in many areas. Lower prices for competitive energy sources and grazing continue to pressure molasses prices in the Midwest.
Westway Trading Corporation has completed the acquisition of Cargill Inc's. molasses division. Traders report good harvest of sugar cane in Mexico, Central America, and Australia.

**Prices represent sales fob terminal to the general feed trade in the respective areas but do not necessarily reflect sales to other trade areas.**
* Includes the major Uppper Mississippi river tributaries with the exception of the Missouri River.
